text: In XTT (Cartesian cubical type theory for sets, Sterling-Harper), compared to CCHM:
choices: XTT adds an 'exact equality' type (strict equality) for h-sets, making UIP provable for sets
explanation: XTT (Sterling-Harper) is a cubical type theory for sets (h-sets) that adds an exact (strict) equality type Id, which satisfies UIP. It is a two-level approach: exact equality for sets, paths for homotopy.
